book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Lucas' pilla Diosa' mika ura kuinda

content: Jesús Zaqueoba
Jesús Jericó pebulunu vijitu, juntsa pebulunu pullantsumi.
Tsenñu juntsa pebulunu main taruku chumi, ya' mumu Zaqueo, matyu deechu' mitya lushi kamuutala bale ruku.
Juntsa rukuya, Jesús naaju ruku juuñuba katanbera tyaturen, yaa da'rukuku' mitya chachilla pure' buluu jiindetsuñu katanu jutyumi,
tsejtu miñu ajkesha daran jitu ma chisha lu-i' keenami, junu Jesús puinu juñu' mitya.
Jesús junu pullandu, kai'sha ke'lare' Zaqueonu katatu tsandimi: Zaqueo, apain manbajade. Uma ñu' yanaa tsunu tsuyu, timi.
Tsandiñu Zaqueo chisha puturen jei manbaijtu, Jesúsnu ya' yasha yuj sunden mikami.
Tsenñu kumuinchi chachilla dekeenatu: Jesús ujcha lamu ruku' yasharen tsunu jive, ti' na'baasa paviikentsula.

Tsenñu Zaqueo uiditu Bale Rukunu tsandimi: Uwain Rukui, in tananu lushi ma tsandaa purelanu deveenu tsuyu; tsenmin mantsa chachillanu anbuti' lushi kamuwaashu juntsaya, juntsalanu taapai bijee jungue mangunu tsuyu, timi.
Tsenñu Jesús Zaqueonu tsandimi: Uma entsa yanu chumula liveeju detiyave, naa entsa ruku bain Abrahamnu sera' jamuren ju' mitya,
matyu Chachi Tiya' Nakayamuya detupiyaa chumu chachillanaa mi'ke' livee kenu jañu' mitya, timi.
Lushi laanutala laapu' kuinda

Jesús tsandintsu chachilla demeenañu, manen vee kuinda malaapu' pami, matyu yumaa Jerusalénsha faajingumakaandetsu' mitya, tsenmin chachilla' pensaya Diosnu yala' rei juu tananu malu wajtunuren entsai katawanu juve detyañu' mitya.
Tsenñu Jesús tsandimi: Main aa bale chachilla' bulu ruku, baasha masku tusha jimi, junga jinmala ya' tusha mandanguen chumu rei tire' me-eenu deeñu.

Tsejtu kayu lu' ji'mujchiren ya' taawasha kemu chachillanu paitya ruku mikatu, main main pen chu'chaya taawasha ke' lushi kakeñungue dekuwami. Tsejtu tsandimi: I majainshabi entsa lushinchi taawasha ke' kayu malaadei, ti' kuwami.
Tsaaren ya' tunu chumu chachillaya yanu tyutyamu de' mitya, dewa'ditu ya' bendala ma bulu chachi kalare' junga eela: Entsa rukunuya lala' rei tirenu tendyuve, tita dejisa tyatu.
Tsenñuren juntsa ruku rei tiya' maami ya' tusha. Tsai' maatu ya' lushi kuwa' shuikiñu chachillanu mamikami nan demalaañuba pake'meenu.
Tsenñu main ajke' jitu tsandimi: Rukui, ñu' lushinchi paitya bijee jungue kayu aa malaayu, timi.
Tsenñu juntsa rei pakatu tsandimi: Ñuya ura' taawasha kemu chachi ju', jayu juunuren ura' keñu' mitya, challaya paitya pebulunu mandanguemu uñi tirenu tsuyu, timi.
Tsenñu kamain bain jitu tsandimi: Rukui, ñu' lushinchi man bijee jungue kayu aa malaayu, timi.
Tsenñu rei tsandimi: Ñunu bain man pebulunu mandanguemu uñi tirenu tsuyu, timi.
Tsenñuren kamain jimuya entsandimi: Rukui, enu ñu' lushi entsanave. Iyaa ñu' lushi katu jalichi kuluke' ne uukaakiyu,
matyu ñuya naa mandangue' bain pajashkityu ju', naa ñuchi jutyuñu bain kayu aa mangamu ju', naa ñuya wajke' puka iwaatyumujchi bain puka iware' kamu juñu, ñunu jeetenñu' mityaa tsanguiyu, timi.

Tsenñu juntsa rei tsandimi: Ñu, ura' taawasha kityu ruku, ñu' palaachiren kuipa vi' kavitu inu tsuve. Ñu iya naake mandangue'ba pajashkityu rukuwaañu bain mimin, naa inchi jui'ñu bain manba'muwaañu bain mimin, naa iya wajtyumujchiren puka iware' kamuwaañu bain mishu juntsaya,
¿nenñaa lushi uukaanu yasha in lushi take' kuwai'yu, i yasha maatu juntsan mitya kayu aa manganutsu? timi.
Tsejtu rei tsandimi junu pumulanu: ¡Juntsanu lushi manchi'ketu, paitya bijee kayu aa malaakiñushu juntsanaa mangudei! timi.
Tsenñu yala tsandila: Rukui, ¡tsaaren yaa yumaa paitya bijee kayu aa tanashuba! tila.
Tsenñu rei pakatu tsandimi: Uwaindiyu, aa tanamulanuya kayu aa manguwanu tsuve, tsaaren jayun taalanuya naa ka jayun tadeeñu bain tsaa millai machipanu detsuve, timi.
Tsenmala inu rei tiyatyusa tyamu kundaalanuya in ajuusha detaja' iya keenaren tu'dei, timi rei.
Jesús Jerusalénsharei juuñuu vijimi.
Jesús tsandi' dyatu, kayu ajkesha jindu Jerusalénsha jinu miñuu jintsumi.
Tsai' jindu Betfagé kaa pebulusha bain, Betania kaa pebulusha bain dekalen jindu, Ulibu chi chunu kuyi keesha dejitu, Jesús pallu ya' disipululanu entsandi pa' kaa pebulusha eemi:
Junbi vijitu ma kaa buru muba chudi' kerajtu teetsuraa uyuna katanu detsuve. Tsejtu juntsa kaa burunu langa' taadei.
Tsenmala mun ñullanu: ¿Tyeenguenaa kaa burunu langandetsuyu? ti' depake'meenmalaya: Bale Ruku menesteve, tidei, timi.
Tsenñu juntsa pai disipulula kaa pebulusha jitu, Jesús naati pa' eeñu bain buru juntsana katajila.
Tsejtu kaa burunu langandetsunmalan buru miya rukula pake'meetu: ¿Tyeenguenaa kaa burunu langandetsuyu? tila.
Tsenñu ya' disipulula pakatu: Bale Ruku menesteve, tila.
Tsejtu Jesús' junga deta'tu, juntsa kaa burunu jali delakare', Jesúsnu e'lare' chujtila.
Tsa-i' ya jintsu kumuinchi chachilla Jesús' jinu miñu ajkesha dejitu, yala' jali miñusha lakare' jijiila balengure' keewaatu.

Tsejtu Jesús ya' disipululaba Ulibu chi chunu butyu kujtutala pajtyaindetsunmalan, junu yaiba bulu jive'mu chachilla: Dios yuj urave, ti' utis jijiila, matyu Dios tiba tsamantsaa jumula deke' keewaañu katamu de' mitya.
Tsejtu entsa entsandila:
Tsa tsa detiñu, mantsa fariseola chachilla' kejtsapala deputu, Jesúsnu tsandila: Rukui, ñu' bendaa nemu chachillanu tsandi pakaan jutyu nepade, tila.
Tsenñu Jesús pakatu: Uwaindiyu, yala dedyañuya, shupukalaa Dios yuj urave, ti' ui'chu deeve, timi.
Tsejtu Jesús dekalen ji', Jerusalén kata-ere', junu chumula' mitya waatu

tsandimi: Ñulla Jerusalén' chulla, tyee tiba bulla jutyu ura' chujtikaamuñuba umaren aseeta dekituya, juntsangue dekisa tenve. Tsaaren challa juntsa pantsunañuu juñu' mitya, ñuichiya naake' katan tsaave.
Matyu mandinbu ñulla' kundaala dejatu, ñulla' aa pebulu kapatala tu veeta deke', yatai de-uidija' dedalekenu detsuve.
Tsanguetu millangue senaa-ere', naa chachillanu bain detuteke', naa shupukala bain yaitala llai'nan jutyungue mushkenu detsuve, matyu Dios ñulla' junga jañuren ñulla dekeengui'ñu' mitya, timi.
Jesús aa eleshaDioschi ura' kuraa mandiremi.
Tsejtu Jesús bene Jerusalén aa elesha chunu veeta juusha vitu, junga tiba atin pumulanu avindala demajuka'laakemi.
Tsejtu tsandimi: Diosa' Kiikanu tsandive: In yaa Diosba kuinda kenu ya junu tsuve,
tive, tsaanuren ñullaya entsa yanu taamula' vi' pantsudinu tujuu tiredekiñuve, timi.

Jesúsya malumere juntsa aa eleshasha mijakares neneintsumi. Tsaaren chachilla' mitya Diosnu kalen jimula' bale rukula bain, naa Moisés' wandya lei mashturula bain, naa judíola' bale rukula bain yalaya Jesúsnu naaketaa tu'naa ju' bain juntsaaya mi'kes nentsula.
Tsejturen naake'ba tibanguenu jutyu jujuula, matyu chachillaya Jesús' palaanu mika tejan meemeedediñu' mitya.
